# Galleon DeFi Infrastructure Skills

> Independently installable infrastructure guidance and read-only diagnostics for DeFi agents.

- [Infrastructure skill](skills/galleon-defi-infra/SKILL.md): RPC, managed wallet, payment and Hermes onboarding.
- [RPC and Alchemy](skills/galleon-defi-infra/references/rpc-alchemy.md): Provider access and network selection.
- [Wallets](skills/galleon-defi-infra/references/wallets.md): Custody and scoped account choices.
- [Payments](skills/galleon-defi-infra/references/payments.md): Spending authority and official x402 tools.
- [Hermes](skills/galleon-defi-infra/references/hermes.md): Native runtime and MCP configuration.
- [Readiness](skills/galleon-defi-infra/references/readiness.md): Bounded RPC checks and truthful status.
